title: The Quality of Tomorrow
description: A demonstration of the people, ideas, and breakthroughs shaping the future of quality engineering.
demoNotice: Interactive prototype. All nominees, organizations, achievements, and winners in this 2027 experience are fictional demo data. This is not an official awards announcement.

criteria.name: Innovation
criteria.description: Originality and thoughtful application of new ideas.

criteria.name: Impact
criteria.description: Meaningful, measurable outcomes for people or products.

criteria.name: Technical Excellence
criteria.description: Craft, reliability, and depth of engineering.

criteria.name: Leadership
criteria.description: Ability to inspire, guide, and elevate others.

criteria.name: Overall Impression
criteria.description: Strength and completeness of the nomination.

categories.name: QA Innovator of the Year
categories.description: Recognizes an individual who has introduced a groundbreaking approach, technology, or methodology that has meaningfully advanced software quality.

categories.name: Excellence in Quality Engineering & Automation
categories.description: Celebrates outstanding use of automation, AI, CI/CD, or engineering practices to improve quality, speed, coverage, or reliability.

categories.name: Innovative QA Organization of the Year
categories.description: Recognizes a company or QA organization that has transformed its quality culture, processes, or operating model and demonstrated measurable results.

categories.name: QA Technology & Tooling Innovation Award
categories.description: Recognizes an exceptional tool, framework, platform, or technology contribution that solves a meaningful quality challenge.

categories.name: Quality Community Champion
categories.description: Celebrates individuals who have significantly contributed to the QA/testing community through mentorship, education, open source, events, content, or advocacy.

categories.name: Rising Star in Quality Engineering
categories.description: Recognizes an emerging QA/quality engineering professional whose contributions demonstrate exceptional potential and impact.

categories.name: Breakthrough QA Practice or Solution
categories.description: Recognizes a novel testing or quality practice, methodology, or solution that has delivered measurable improvements and can be scaled or replicated.

categories.name: Sponsor’s Choice Award
categories.description: Recognizes an individual or partner organization that has made an outstanding contribution to advancing quality, promoting continuous improvement, or demonstrating excellence in products, services, processes, or organizational performance.
